|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “▲ any Cave. OR If opponent just deployed a planet site, ▼any related location.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Take a cave into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just deployed a planet site, deploy a related location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “▲ any Cave.” → “Take a cave into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “▼any” → “deploy a”; “location.” → “location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 26. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion]].
* Later text: [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion]].
